text:
noah_sales: AtlasPay POC failing intermittently with 429s during checkout load test. Started ~13:40 UTC. They hit it while doing concurrent embed+chat for personalization calls.

noah_sales: Client shows: `HTTP/1.1 429` headers: ```X-RDX-Limit: 5000\nX-RDX-Remaining: 0\nX-RDX-Reset: 1823456720\nRetry-After: 6```

hema_se: Do we know if AtlasPay has any per-route reservations? Could be per-route caps + global cap interaction.

kai_eng: Pulling proxy slices now. Short log:```[1823456715] acct=atlaspay route=/v1/embeddings tokens=320 bucket_before=420 bucket_after=100
[1823456716] acct=atlaspay route=/v1/chat tokens=200 bucket_before=100 bucket_after=-100 throttle=1 -> 429
[1823456718] acct=atlaspay route=/v1/embeddings tokens=400 bucket_before=-100 bucket_after=-500 throttle=1 -> 429```

oliver_support: The negative bucket indicates burst exhausted. They ran multiple parallel import jobs plus realtime chat, so aggregate exceeded the tenant burst window.

hema_se: Quick fixes for presales: 1) reduce embed batch size (from 256 to 64) 2) cap concurrent embed workers to 3 3) add exponential backoff with jitter on 429.

noah_sales: Customer asks if we can just flip a switch to let their run complete. Small temporary bump OK?

kai_eng: We can issue a 2-hour burst override: id=ovr-20260321-771 apply: acct.atlaspay.burst_add=3000 ttl=7200. Need opt-in audit and billing OK.

quota_bot: [quota-check] acct=atlaspay monthly_commit=500k tokens available_for_override=12000 credit_status=good

noah_sales: Approve 2h override. Please annotate in deal notes and revert after.

kai_eng: Applied override ovr-20260321-771 by=kai_eng expires=1823463930

oliver_support: AtlasPay confirmed demo completed after override + throttling changes. Recommend adding runbook snippet to presales: include expected token cost per example request and an embed-splitting helper.

hema_se: Also filing follow-up: RDX-1258 to surface "aggregate remaining" in console and API header so clients can backoff deterministically.

noah_sales: Thanks team. I'll share the runbook with AtlasPay and attach to the deal. :thumbsup:
